name: Atmospheric Lighting Model
definition: A lighting model that attenuates light through the volume, providing simple but robust lighting without relying on a surface normal. It is used for multi-field gradients because the gradient orientation may not correspond to the surface of the classified region and can flip direction.
summary: The Atmospheric Lighting Model is a volume shading technique that avoids surface normal ambiguity by attenuating light through the volume and modulating voxel color by summed attenuation.
